# Evaluation: busi-vit-257147b3-onnx

*Generated by `ai-service/scripts/evaluate-cancer-models.py` on 2026-11-16.*

**Data:** BUS-BRA (Gomez-Flores et al. 2024, Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.8231412, CC BY 4.0): 1,875 biopsy-proven breast ultrasound images from 1,064 patients in Brazil, external to the model's training data (BUSI). Split by patient: 30% calibration, 70% test. BUS-BRA has no "normal" images, so the model's normal class is never correct here.

Calibration split: 565 images. Test split: 1310 images (752 groups).

## Headline metrics (test split, argmax decision)

| Metric | Value (95% CI) |
|---|---|
| Accuracy | 76.2% (73.8-78.4) |
| Balanced accuracy | 67.6% |
| Macro F1 | 0.694 |
| Macro AUC (one vs rest) | 0.812 |
| Cancer vs not: sensitivity | 43.5% (38.9-48.3) |
| Cancer vs not: specificity | 92.8% (90.9-94.3) |
| Cancer vs not: F1 | 0.548 |
| Cancer vs not: AUC | 0.817 (0.793-0.840) |

Cancer classes in the binary view: malignant. Intervals: Wilson score for proportions, stratified-free bootstrap (2,000 resamples) for AUC.
